name: Billing Spine
summary: Normalized subscriptions, local entitlement checks, idempotent usage metering, and dunning escalation.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Branch connection string. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: BILLING_GRACE_PERIOD_DAYS
env.description: Days of continued access after a payment fails. A failed payment is usually an expired card, not a churn decision, so cutting access instantly turns a recoverable problem into a lost customer.

env.name: BILLING_DUNNING_SCHEDULE
env.description: Comma-separated days-overdue thresholds at which to escalate, e.g. 0,3,7,14.

env.name: BILLING_TRIAL_WARNING_DAYS
env.description: How far ahead to announce a trial ending.

triggers.description: Dunning escalation, trial-expiry notices, and usage rollups. Off-peak and off the hour.
